objective: The compose experience: a PostBuilder that assembles and validates a CreatePostRequest, a ComposeMediator through which the text box, the mention autocomplete and the media widget communicate, a DraftSnapshot undo, quick-post templates cloned from a prototype, and direct-to-S3 media upload via the presigned POST from POST /media/uploads.
acceptance_criteria: PostBuilder accumulates text, media ids and reply/repost context across separate calls, and build() rejects a post with neither text nor media rather than sending an empty request.
The text box, the mention autocomplete and the media widget exchange state only through ComposeMediator; no two of those components import each other.
Typing '#' offers games from GET /events/games and typing '$' offers teams from GET /events/teams, and selecting a suggestion inserts the mention token the backend parses.
DraftSnapshot captures the draft before live-event data is attached, and undo restores the exact prior draft including text, media ids and reply context.
PostTemplate.clone() produces an independent draft, and editing a draft created from a template leaves the template itself unchanged.
Media upload sends a multipart POST of the presigned fields plus the file directly to the returned upload_url, and never sends file bytes to the API.
A file whose type is outside jpeg/png/webp, or whose size exceeds the max_bytes returned by POST /media/uploads, is rejected client-side with a visible message before any upload is attempted.
After upload the widget polls GET /media/{media_id} and only allows attaching the media once its state is Processed; media still Quarantined cannot be attached.
Submitting a valid draft issues POST /posts with the built request, clears the composer on success, and preserves the draft on failure so the user does not lose their text.
